Xia.name: Yu
Xia.title: Yu the Great
Xia.note: Reign dates are rough estimates; the Xia kings are known only from much later texts.
Xia.note_zh: 在位年代只是粗略估计，夏代君王只见于后世文献。

Xia.name: Qi
Xia.title: Qi of Xia
Xia.note: Reign dates are rough estimates; the Xia kings are known only from much later texts.
Xia.note_zh: 在位年代只是粗略估计，夏代君王只见于后世文献。

Xia.name: Shao Kang
Xia.title: Shao Kang
Xia.note: Remembered for restoring the Xia after a usurpation; dates are estimates.
Xia.note_zh: 传说他在夏朝王位被篡夺后复兴了夏朝；年代为估计。

Xia.name: Lü Gui
Xia.title: Jie of Xia
Xia.note: The last Xia king; dates are estimates.
Xia.note_zh: 夏朝末代君王；年代为估计。

check.n: Legendary last Xia ruler; traditional dates 1728-1675 BC differ from the c. 1600 BC end of Xia.
check.n_zh: 夏代传说末代君主；传统纪年为公元前1728-1675年，与约公元前1600年夏亡之说不同。

qi-battle-of-gan.note: Known only from the Book of Documents chapter 'Speech at Gan'; details are legendary.
qi-battle-of-gan.note_zh: 此事只见于《尚书·甘誓》，细节带有传说色彩。

routes.name: Qi marches west against the Youhu
routes.summary: By tradition Qi led his army from the Xia heartland in western Henan to Gan, near today's Xi'an; the exact route is unknown.
routes.summary_zh: 相传启从豫西的夏人中心地区出兵，西至今西安附近的甘地；具体路线不详。

people.name: Xi Zhong
people.known_for: In tradition he was the Xia official in charge of carts and is credited with inventing the horse-drawn cart.
people.known_for_zh: 相传为夏朝的车正，被尊为马车的发明者。

people.name: Yi Di
people.known_for: Ancient texts say Yi Di made fine wine and presented it to Yu the Great; she is a legendary pioneer of brewing.
people.known_for_zh: 古书记载仪狄造出美酒献给大禹，是传说中的酿酒始祖。

people.name: Yu the Great
people.known_for: Legendary tamer of the Great Flood by dredging channels; founder of the Xia dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 治水十三年三过家门而不入，开创夏朝。

people.name: Gao Yao
people.known_for: Legendary minister of justice under Shun and Yu, revered as the founder of Chinese law and prisons.
people.known_for_zh: 舜禹时期掌管刑狱的贤臣，被尊为中国司法鼻祖。

people.name: Hou Yi
people.known_for: Legendary master archer who seized power from the Xia king Tai Kang before being killed by Han Zhuo.
people.known_for_zh: 善射的有穷氏首领，代夏执政，后被寒浞所杀。

people.name: Shao Kang
people.known_for: Restored Xia rule after the usurpations of Hou Yi and Han Zhuo, an episode remembered as the Restoration of Shao Kang.
people.known_for_zh: 击灭寒浞恢复夏朝统治，史称少康中兴。

check.n: Legendary Xia king; dates are not historically established.
check.n_zh: 夏代传说君主，年代无史实可证。

people.name: Tang of Shang
people.known_for: Overthrew the tyrant Jie of Xia at the Battle of Mingtiao and founded the Shang dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 鸣条之战灭夏桀，建立商朝。

people.name: Zhong Hui
people.known_for: Chief minister alongside Yi Yin who helped Tang overthrow the Xia; credited with the Announcement of Zhong Hui.
people.known_for_zh: 与伊尹同辅商汤灭夏的左相，作《仲虺之诰》。

check.n: Matched page is Zhong Hui (225-264) of Cao Wei; entry with death c.1580 BC likely refers to Zhonghui, legendary minister of Tang of Shang; date legendary.
check.n_zh: 匹配页面为曹魏钟会(225-264)；约前1580年卒应指商汤大臣仲虺，年代属传说，无法核实。

capitals.name: Yangcheng
capitals.note: Traditional capital of Yu; often linked to the Wangchenggang site. Dates are traditional.
capitals.note_zh: 传说中禹的都城，常与王城岗遗址对应，年代为传统说法。

capitals.name: Zhenxun
capitals.note: Late Xia capital, widely identified with the Erlitou site; dates are archaeological estimates.
capitals.note_zh: 夏代晚期都城，多认为即二里头遗址，年代为考古估计。
